argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
It is interesting to contemplate an entangled bank, clothed with many plants of many kinds, with birds singing on the bushes, with various insects flitting about, and with worms crawling through the damp earth, and to reflect that these elaborately constructed forms, so different from each other, and dependent on each other in so complex a manner, have all been produced by laws acting around us. These laws, taken in the largest sense, being Growth with Reproduction; Inheritance which is almost implied by reproduction; Variability from the indirect and direct action of the external conditions of life, and from use and disuse; a Ratio of Increase so high as to lead to a Struggle for Life, and as a consequence to Natural Selection, entailing Divergence of Character and the Extinction of less-improved forms. Thus, from the war of nature, from famine and death, the most exalted object which we are capable of conceiving, namely, the production of the higher animals, directly follows. There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed into a few forms or into one; and that, whilst this planet has gone cycling on according to the fixed law of gravity, from so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being, evolved.
</passage>

response.text:
It could, in some sense, be regarded as a value-add exercise to engage in the contemplation of a multi-stakeholder biodiversity ecosystem—one characterized by a robust portfolio of flora across numerous verticals, an ambient soundscape attributable to avian actors situated within shrub-based infrastructure, a range of entomological units engaged in low-altitude mobility, and subsurface annelid activity within moisture-optimized soil substrates—and to arrive, however provisionally, at the reflection that these deliverables, each highly differentiated and yet interdependent within a complex operational framework, may be understood to have been generated through the operationalisation of ambient environmental protocols.

These protocols, when viewed at scale, may be broadly conceptualized as encompassing: a Growth-Reproduction synergy; an Inheritance function that is arguably, though not without qualification, implicit within reproductive processes; a Variability parameter, itself contingent on both indirect and direct environmental input variables as well as usage/non-usage differentials; and an Increase Ratio of such magnitude as to necessitate a Struggle-for-Life framework, which in turn is understood to give rise—albeit through pathways not fully de-risked—to a Natural Selection mechanism, entailing downstream Character Divergence and the sunsetting of legacy, less-optimized forms.

It might tentatively be suggested, then, that from this ongoing competitive landscape—characterized by resource scarcity and attritional outcomes—there follows, in what could perhaps be considered the most aspirational deliverable within the conceptual space available to stakeholders, the emergence of higher-order faunal entities.

There exists, arguably, a certain grandeur-adjacent quality to this framework of life, wherein its constituent capacities are understood to have been, at some point, instantiated across a limited set of foundational forms, or potentially a singular originating form; and wherein, concurrently, this planetary asset has continued its ongoing lifecycle in alignment with fixed gravitational governance structures, such that, from so minimal a baseline, an effectively unbounded array of highly differentiated, aesthetically and functionally significant outputs have been, and continue to be, operationalised.
